meta.description:
[#ff5959[]]PREPARE YOURSELF!

[#ffffff[]]A mod about [#ff5959[]]sword [#ffffff[]]& the 7 sword deities from PHIGHTING!
[grey[]](along with 3 characters related to the swords)

[#ffffff[]]Create [#ff5959[]]swordium [#ffffff[]]& convert it into either [#70AC30[]]darkheartium[#ffffff[]], [#861C00[]]firebrandium[#ffffff[]], [#C2C2C2[]]ghostwalkerium[#ffffff[]], [#97CCE1[]]icedaggerium[#ffffff[]], [#E2BAF5[]]illuminaium[#ffffff[]], [#A4C360[]]venomshankium [#ffffff[]]or [#929EAE[]]windforceium[#ffffff[]], along with [#3a3a82[]]ban-hammerium[#ffffff[]] & the [#EBE161[]]flip[#ffffff[]][#C46BE3[]]side[#ffffff[]] group of [#EBE161[]]valkium [#ffffff[]]& [#C46BE3[]]domium[#ffffff[]].

There's multiple types of turrets, production buildings, units & even a mobile [#ff5959[]]swordium [#ffffff[]]core that you can place down anywhere!

What's special about this mod is that it has interplanetary construction!
whether if it's erekir, serpulo or any planet mod, you can construct the mod's factories there!
[grey[]]provided that the sector doesn't have restricted blocks.

[grey[]]please note that researching PHIGHTING! [#ff5959[]]SWORD [grey[]]DEITIES requires the materials to be on serpulo.
  
[red[]]note: this mod can be considered as unfair to some, but then again, play it your own way!
